bias.en: Bearish · below the 30-day, September lows tested
bias.zh: 偏空 · 位于 30 日均线下方，测试 9 月低点

read.en: SpaceX fell 2.3% on Oct 15 to $148.62 after an intraday low of $140.66; with 87 sessions of history it has no 100 or 200-day averages yet. It is below its falling 5-day ($156.7), 10-day ($161.3) and 30-day ($153.6) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 14 and is still above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 14 ($175.9), and RSI is 45.
read.zh: SpaceX 10月15日盘中跌至 $140.66 后回升，下跌 2.3%，收于 $148.62；上市仅 87 个交易日，尚无 100 日和 200 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$156.7）、10 日（$161.3）和 30 日均线（$153.6）下方。MACD 自 10月14日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月14日起看空（$175.9），RSI 为 45。

read.en: The day's low undercut the $145.4 Sep 28 and $142.9 Sep 15 lows, but the close held above both. Resistance is $153.6 (30-day average; Oct 14 close $152.16), then $156.7 (5-day) and $161.3 (10-day). Support is $145.4, then $140.7 (Oct 15 low) and $130.4 (Aug 20 low). A close below $140.7 would open $130.4; a close above $153.6 would target $161.
